# v0.2 stability report - STA (generated by scripts/sta_stats.py)

## How to read it

1. High STA = repeated runs of the same event produce the same kind of thing; the score can be quoted per event.
2. Low STA = run the event several times and deliver the consensus, or upgrade the model and re-run.
3. We commit to 'a consistent level across repeated runs', never to 'the same conclusion every time'.

> Reproduce: `python scripts/sta_stats.py --out data/repeat_v02`
